record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Prayer<WH08605> of Moses<WH04872> the man<WH0376> of God<WH0430>.<Fo><Fo> Lord<WH0136>, thou hast been our dwelling place<WH04583> in all<WH01755> generations<WH01755>. <RF>A Prayer...: or, A Prayer, being a Psalm of Moses<Rf> <RF>in...: Heb. in generation and generation<Rf>

Before the mountains<WH02022> were brought forth<WH03205><WTH8795>, or ever thou hadst formed<WH02342><WTH8787> the earth<WH0776> and the world<WH08398>, even from everlasting<WH05769> to<WH05704> everlasting<WH05769>, thou <FI>art<Fi> God<WH0410>.
Thou turnest<WH07725><WTH8686> man<WH0582> to destruction<WH01793>; and sayest<WH0559><WTH8799>, Return<WH07725><WTH8798>, ye children<WH01121> of men<WH0120>.

For a thousand<WH0505> years<WH08141> in thy sight<WH05869> <FI>are but<Fi> as<WH03117> yesterday<WH0865> when it is past<WH05674><WTH8799>, and <FI>as<Fi> a watch<WH0821> in the night<WH03915>. <RF>when...: or, when he hath passed them<Rf>

Thou carriest them away as with a flood<WH02229><WTH8804>; they are <FI>as<Fi> a sleep<WH08142>: in the morning<WH01242> <FI>they are<Fi> like grass<WH02682> <FI>which<Fi> groweth up<WH02498><WTH8799>. <RF>groweth...: or, is changed<Rf>
In the morning<WH01242> it flourisheth<WH06692><WTH8686>, and groweth up<WH02498><WTH8804>; in the evening<WH06153> it is cut down<WH04135><WTH8787>, and withereth<WH03001><WTH8804>.<CM>
For we are consumed<WH03615><WTH8804> by thine anger<WH0639>, and by thy wrath<WH02534> are we troubled<WH0926><WTH8738>.
Thou hast set<WH07896><WTH8804> our iniquities<WH05771> before thee, our secret<WH05956><WTH8803> <FI>sins<Fi> in the light<WH03974> of thy countenance<WH06440>.

For all our days<WH03117> are passed away<WH06437><WTH8804> in thy wrath<WH05678>: we spend<WH03615><WTH8765> our years<WH08141> as a tale<WH01899> <FI>that is told<Fi> . <RF>passed...: Heb. turned away<Rf> <RF>as a...: or, as a meditation<Rf>

The days<WH03117> of our years<WH08141> <FI>are<Fi> threescore<WH07657><WH00> years<WH08141> and ten<WH07657>; and if by reason of strength<WH01369> <FI>they be<Fi> fourscore<WH08084> years<WH08141>, yet <FI>is<Fi> their strength<WH07296> labour<WH05999> and sorrow<WH0205>; for it is soon<WH02440> cut off<WH01468><WTH8804>, and we fly away<WH05774><WTH8799>. <RF>The days...: Heb. As for the days of our years, in them are seventy years<Rf>
Who knoweth<WH03045><WTH8802> the power<WH05797> of thine anger<WH0639>? even according to thy fear<WH03374>, <FI>so is<Fi> thy wrath<WH05678>.<CM>

So teach<WH03045><WTH8685> <FI>us<Fi> to number<WH04487><WTH8800> our days<WH03117>, that we may apply<WH0935><WTH8686> <FI>our<Fi> hearts<WH03824> unto wisdom<WH02451>. <RF>apply: Heb. cause to come<Rf>
Return<WH07725><WTH8798>, O LORD<WH03068>, how long? and let it repent<WH05162><WTH8734> thee concerning thy servants<WH05650>.
O satisfy<WH07646><WTH8761> us early<WH01242> with thy mercy<WH02617>; that we may rejoice<WH07442><WTH8762> and be glad<WH08055><WTH8799> all our days<WH03117>.

Make us glad<WH08055><WTH8761> according to the days<WH03117> <FI>wherein<Fi> thou hast afflicted<WH06031><WTH8765> us, <FI>and<Fi> the years<WH08141> <FI>wherein<Fi> we have seen<WH07200><WTH8804> evil<WH07451>.
Let thy work<WH06467> appear<WH07200><WTH8735> unto thy servants<WH05650>, and thy glory<WH01926> unto their children<WH01121>.

And let the beauty<WH05278> of the LORD<WH03068> our God<WH0430> be upon us: and establish<WH03559><WTH8786> thou the work<WH04639> of our hands<WH03027> upon us; yea, the work<WH04639> of our hands<WH03027> establish<WH03559><WTH8786> thou it.<CM>
